meta.semantics: site-level virtual-dispatch receiver origin equivalence: the receiver at site S (slot N, vptr_off K) is the value of entity E (T:FN this / M:FN:this:off member / P:FN:k param / EAX:FN:callsite return / G:addr global). Consumption like vt_receiver_bindings recv entities: land C3 slot-mask (K=0 primary) or C30 secondary-offset mask (K>0) on E, instead of the function-level R:<fn>:<reg> aggregate.
meta.method: call [r2+N] -> nearest def of r2 must be mov r2,[recv(+K)] (<=8 instr, label/jmp bounded => same basic region, sound reaching def); recv def traced <=8 instr / <=3 copy hops; entry-ecx undef-since-entry = this (thiscall|fastcall proto); [ebp+8+4k] / arg_k = param k (fastcall excluded: ecosystem has no fastcall param entities); mov R,eax with nearest eax def = call => EAX entity; offset/known-global => G entity. R:<fn>:<reg> register aggregates NEVER emitted (unsound).
meta.alignment: entity formats aligned with vt_receiver_bindings.json (site-keyed binds, recv=T:/M: slot entities) => site-level channel, equivalence edges emitted; VB is NOT a function-level register aggregate so the AND-merge objection does not apply (T/M/P/EAX/G are value-slot entities, type-sound across sites). Nested chains => evidence only (vr-nested).

tiers.strict: receiver/base defs resolved within label-bounded <=8-instr windows (sound reaching def on every path)
tiers.fullspan: entry-this alias via LAST textual def `mov reg, ecx` (callee-saved reg, ecx entry-undef) — linear last-def approximation, same trust tier as the ecosystem's T-entity alias handling; separable via edge.tier

meta.dedup: vt_receiver_bindings.json = callee slot binding, no origin equivalence (independent channel); vtcall_receivers.json = 1347 empty-receiver IDA-dataflow sites (this/member subset); callarg_origins.json = ffl5 def-direct arg origins (receiver edges exist there for vtable_slot_ sites; this channel re-derives with label-bounded sound windows + EAX/G/nested vocabulary). corr=relocated/dropped marks sites already corrected/dropped by minclass_evidence_corrections.json.
